# Rodo's Crappy Web Empire (RCWE)

> A collection of experimental and playful web tools, primarily built around the LODTE (La Orden del Tabernero Errante) D&D campaign ecosystem.
> Side project hub of [Rodolfo Agustín García](https://ragustingarcia.com/).
> Tagline: "Made with more enthusiasm than budget."

This is the LLM-friendly version of [rcwe.ragustingarcia.com](https://rcwe.ragustingarcia.com/), formatted in Markdown for easy parsing by AI assistants.

## About

Rodo's Crappy Web Empire (RCWE) is the experimental side of Rodolfo Agustín García's portfolio. The main portfolio at [ragustingarcia.com](https://ragustingarcia.com/) hosts production projects with real users; RCWE hosts side projects, experiments, and tools made for fun.

The current focus is on tooling for **LODTE — La Orden del Tabernero Errante**, a D&D (Dungeons & Dragons) campaign ecosystem. See [lodte.com.ar](https://www.lodte.com.ar/) for the broader LODTE world.

## Projects

### El Códice del Tabernero
Polyalphabetic cipher tool for D&D campaigns. Lets dungeon masters create encoded messages for their players to decipher in-game.
- Status: live
- Link: https://elcodicedeltabernero.netlify.app/
- Stack: HTML/CSS/JavaScript (vanilla)

### Los Dados del Tabernero
D&D 5e dice roller. Supports standard D&D dice notation (1d20, 4d6kh3, etc.) with rolling history and customization.
- Status: live
- Link: https://losdadosdeltabernero.netlify.app/
- Stack: HTML/CSS/JavaScript (vanilla)

### Sala de Mapas
Real-time shared map viewer for D&D sessions. Multiple players can connect and see the same map updated live by the dungeon master.
- Status: live
- Link: https://lodte-sala-de-mapas.onrender.com/
- Stack: Python, Flask, SocketIO, MongoDB, Cloudinary

### CAPSULE
Time-locked encrypted letters. AES-256-GCM in the browser, downloadable .capsule file, and a server that custodies only the temporal fragment of the key (minimum 3 years). Three separate pieces (message + secret phrase + server fragment) — nothing decrypts until the chosen date arrives. Features 600,000 PBKDF2 iterations, optional one-shot mode (capsule self-destructs after first read), and USB keyfile support.
- Status: live
- Link: https://rcwe-capsule.netlify.app/
- Stack: Vanilla JavaScript, Web Crypto API (AES-256-GCM), PBKDF2

### El Tabernero
Local D&D 5e campaign logger and tracker: characters, sessions and chronicles from a local web UI. Records session audio that El Caldero later processes. Runs locally, no public deploy.
- Status: live (local tool)
- Stack: Python, FastAPI, vanilla JavaScript

### El Caldero del Tabernero
Local AI module that turns D&D session audio (recorded by El Tabernero) into narrative: transcribes, diarizes (separates speakers) and rewrites it as prose. Built for sessions up to ~4 hours via a map-reduce pipeline. Runs locally.
- Status: live (local tool)
- Stack: Python, local AI (transcription + diarization + LLM rewrite)

### El Escriba
Instrument tuner with real-time pitch detection and an audio visualizer. It reads the microphone, computes the fundamental frequency and shows which note is being played and how far off it is. Runs entirely in the browser with the Web Audio API, nothing to install.
- Status: live (local tool)
- Stack: Vanilla JavaScript, Web Audio API

This site is part of [ragustingarcia.com](https://ragustingarcia.com/). The main portfolio shows production projects (commercial / professional); RCWE shows the experimental side (creative / playful). Both are made by the same person.
